notes: Ethereum mainnet (chain 1). LaunchToken has no constructor arguments. BegVault constructor arguments are token, team beneficiary, Intake, IMD fee token, oracle signer, and attempt price in wei. $owner receives the team share and has no administrative powers. BegVault has no owner, setters, pause or upgradeability. The factory sends 80% of the launch supply directly to BegVault and 10% to the pool. Intake, IMD and signer addresses match the accepted README deployment table dated 2026-10-10; live endpoint verification is not claimed. Attempts cost 0.005 ETH. Intake requests use bytes32[] scores and require separate IMD donations through fundOracle(uint256); oracleTokenBudget reports IMD while oracleBudget holds ETH for revealer bounties, with no conversion between assets. Graded escrow is split as claim credits: one tenth to the team, at most 0.001 ETH of a second tenth to the ETH bounty budget (one revealer bounty per batch), and the remainder to jackpotBank. Payouts and refunds use pull claims. Open messages are kept in small CREATE data contracts rather than vault storage until the batch closes. The accepted implementation uses block-based randomness and allows rearming missed reveal windows. Dead-man path: retire() is permissionless and only callable once a batch has expired unanswered for 30 days with no graded batch awaiting reveal; it credits the free BEG, jackpotBank and bounty budget to the team as claimable balances and blocks new attempts, while player refunds stay available. Its automatic-closing twentieth attempt exceeds the 250k gas target; messages must be valid UTF-8 and fit the bounded JSON request budget. No initialization calls are required.
